# numpyro_forecast

> A JAX/NumPyro port of Pyro's forecasting module.

## Docs

### API Reference

#### Forecasters
> High-level interfaces for fitting and forecasting.

- [forecaster.Forecaster](https://juanitorduz.github.io/numpyro_forecast/reference/forecaster.Forecaster.html)
- [forecaster.HMCForecaster](https://juanitorduz.github.io/numpyro_forecast/reference/forecaster.HMCForecaster.html)
- [forecaster.PathfinderForecaster](https://juanitorduz.github.io/numpyro_forecast/reference/forecaster.PathfinderForecaster.html)

#### Models
> Building forecasting models (object-oriented and functional).

- [forecaster.ForecastingModel](https://juanitorduz.github.io/numpyro_forecast/reference/forecaster.ForecastingModel.html)
- [functional.models.forecasting_model](https://juanitorduz.github.io/numpyro_forecast/reference/functional.models.forecasting_model.html)

#### Functional core: model primitives
> Pure functional primitives for the train/forecast split.

- [functional.models.Horizon](https://juanitorduz.github.io/numpyro_forecast/reference/functional.models.Horizon.html)
- [functional.models.time_series](https://juanitorduz.github.io/numpyro_forecast/reference/functional.models.time_series.html)
- [functional.models.markov_time_series](https://juanitorduz.github.io/numpyro_forecast/reference/functional.models.markov_time_series.html)
- [functional.models.predict](https://juanitorduz.github.io/numpyro_forecast/reference/functional.models.predict.html)
- [functional.models.predict_glm](https://juanitorduz.github.io/numpyro_forecast/reference/functional.models.predict_glm.html)

#### Functional core: fitting
> Optimizer/guide/kernel resolution and the SVI and MCMC fit entry points.

- [functional.svi.resolve_optimizer](https://juanitorduz.github.io/numpyro_forecast/reference/functional.svi.resolve_optimizer.html)
- [functional.svi.resolve_guide](https://juanitorduz.github.io/numpyro_forecast/reference/functional.svi.resolve_guide.html)
- [functional.svi.fit_svi](https://juanitorduz.github.io/numpyro_forecast/reference/functional.svi.fit_svi.html)
- [functional.svi.SVIFit](https://juanitorduz.github.io/numpyro_forecast/reference/functional.svi.SVIFit.html)
- [functional.mcmc.resolve_kernel](https://juanitorduz.github.io/numpyro_forecast/reference/functional.mcmc.resolve_kernel.html)
- [functional.mcmc.fit_mcmc](https://juanitorduz.github.io/numpyro_forecast/reference/functional.mcmc.fit_mcmc.html)
- [functional.mcmc.MCMCFit](https://juanitorduz.github.io/numpyro_forecast/reference/functional.mcmc.MCMCFit.html)

#### Functional core: posterior and prediction
> Drawing posterior samples and generating forecasts and in-sample predictions.

- [functional.posterior.draw_posterior](https://juanitorduz.github.io/numpyro_forecast/reference/functional.posterior.draw_posterior.html)
- [functional.prediction.forecast](https://juanitorduz.github.io/numpyro_forecast/reference/functional.prediction.forecast.html)
- [functional.prediction.predict_in_sample](https://juanitorduz.github.io/numpyro_forecast/reference/functional.prediction.predict_in_sample.html)

#### Backtesting & evaluation
> Rolling-window backtesting and forecast metrics.

- [evaluate.backtest](https://juanitorduz.github.io/numpyro_forecast/reference/evaluate.backtest.html)
- [evaluate.backtest_vectorized](https://juanitorduz.github.io/numpyro_forecast/reference/evaluate.backtest_vectorized.html)
- [evaluate.BacktestResult](https://juanitorduz.github.io/numpyro_forecast/reference/evaluate.BacktestResult.html)
- [evaluate.VectorizedBacktestResult](https://juanitorduz.github.io/numpyro_forecast/reference/evaluate.VectorizedBacktestResult.html)
- [evaluate.evaluate_forecast](https://juanitorduz.github.io/numpyro_forecast/reference/evaluate.evaluate_forecast.html)
- [evaluate.results_to_dataframe](https://juanitorduz.github.io/numpyro_forecast/reference/evaluate.results_to_dataframe.html)
- [evaluate.eval_crps](https://juanitorduz.github.io/numpyro_forecast/reference/evaluate.eval_crps.html)
- [evaluate.eval_mae](https://juanitorduz.github.io/numpyro_forecast/reference/evaluate.eval_mae.html)
- [evaluate.eval_rmse](https://juanitorduz.github.io/numpyro_forecast/reference/evaluate.eval_rmse.html)
- [evaluate.eval_coverage](https://juanitorduz.github.io/numpyro_forecast/reference/evaluate.eval_coverage.html)
- [metrics.crps_empirical](https://juanitorduz.github.io/numpyro_forecast/reference/metrics.crps_empirical.html)
- [metrics.eval_pinball](https://juanitorduz.github.io/numpyro_forecast/reference/metrics.eval_pinball.html)
- [metrics.eval_interval_score](https://juanitorduz.github.io/numpyro_forecast/reference/metrics.eval_interval_score.html)
- [metrics.make_mase](https://juanitorduz.github.io/numpyro_forecast/reference/metrics.make_mase.html)

#### Seasonal features
> Fourier design matrices and seasonal tiling.

- [features.fourier_features](https://juanitorduz.github.io/numpyro_forecast/reference/features.fourier_features.html)
- [features.periodic_repeat](https://juanitorduz.github.io/numpyro_forecast/reference/features.periodic_repeat.html)

#### Array helpers
> Time-axis array shaping for the train/forecast split.

- [arrays.zero_data_like](https://juanitorduz.github.io/numpyro_forecast/reference/arrays.zero_data_like.html)
- [arrays.concat_future](https://juanitorduz.github.io/numpyro_forecast/reference/arrays.concat_future.html)

#### Distribution surgery
> Time-axis operations on observation distributions, extensible via singledispatch.

- [surgery.shift_loc](https://juanitorduz.github.io/numpyro_forecast/reference/surgery.shift_loc.html)
- [surgery.slice_time](https://juanitorduz.github.io/numpyro_forecast/reference/surgery.slice_time.html)
- [surgery.prefix_condition](https://juanitorduz.github.io/numpyro_forecast/reference/surgery.prefix_condition.html)
- [surgery.register_elementwise](https://juanitorduz.github.io/numpyro_forecast/reference/surgery.register_elementwise.html)

#### Optional dependencies
> Lazy imports behind pyproject extras.

- [optional.require](https://juanitorduz.github.io/numpyro_forecast/reference/optional.require.html)

#### Exceptions
> Package exception hierarchy raised at resolution and validation boundaries.

- [exceptions.NumpyroForecastError](https://juanitorduz.github.io/numpyro_forecast/reference/exceptions.NumpyroForecastError.html)
- [exceptions.BacktestWindowError](https://juanitorduz.github.io/numpyro_forecast/reference/exceptions.BacktestWindowError.html)
- [exceptions.VectorizedGuideError](https://juanitorduz.github.io/numpyro_forecast/reference/exceptions.VectorizedGuideError.html)
- [exceptions.VectorizedMetricError](https://juanitorduz.github.io/numpyro_forecast/reference/exceptions.VectorizedMetricError.html)
- [exceptions.OptimizerResolutionError](https://juanitorduz.github.io/numpyro_forecast/reference/exceptions.OptimizerResolutionError.html)
- [exceptions.GuideResolutionError](https://juanitorduz.github.io/numpyro_forecast/reference/exceptions.GuideResolutionError.html)
- [exceptions.GuideSampleArgsError](https://juanitorduz.github.io/numpyro_forecast/reference/exceptions.GuideSampleArgsError.html)
- [exceptions.KernelResolutionError](https://juanitorduz.github.io/numpyro_forecast/reference/exceptions.KernelResolutionError.html)
- [exceptions.KernelConfigError](https://juanitorduz.github.io/numpyro_forecast/reference/exceptions.KernelConfigError.html)
- [exceptions.CovariateDimsError](https://juanitorduz.github.io/numpyro_forecast/reference/exceptions.CovariateDimsError.html)
- [exceptions.MVNLayoutError](https://juanitorduz.github.io/numpyro_forecast/reference/exceptions.MVNLayoutError.html)
- [exceptions.DeviceMemoryError](https://juanitorduz.github.io/numpyro_forecast/reference/exceptions.DeviceMemoryError.html)

#### ArviZ export
> Convert fits into ArviZ-schema xarray DataTrees for diagnostics and plotting.

- [convert.to_datatree](https://juanitorduz.github.io/numpyro_forecast/reference/convert.to_datatree.html)
- [convert.add_forecast_groups](https://juanitorduz.github.io/numpyro_forecast/reference/convert.add_forecast_groups.html)
- [convert.predictions_to_datatree](https://juanitorduz.github.io/numpyro_forecast/reference/convert.predictions_to_datatree.html)

#### Extensions (contrib)
> Optional backends behind pyproject extras (never imported by default).

- [contrib.blackjax.BlackjaxNUTSKernel](https://juanitorduz.github.io/numpyro_forecast/reference/contrib.blackjax.BlackjaxNUTSKernel.html)
- [contrib.blackjax.BlackjaxMCLMCKernel](https://juanitorduz.github.io/numpyro_forecast/reference/contrib.blackjax.BlackjaxMCLMCKernel.html)
- [contrib.blackjax.BlackjaxCustomKernel](https://juanitorduz.github.io/numpyro_forecast/reference/contrib.blackjax.BlackjaxCustomKernel.html)
- [contrib.blackjax.PathfinderFit](https://juanitorduz.github.io/numpyro_forecast/reference/contrib.blackjax.PathfinderFit.html)
- [contrib.blackjax.fit_pathfinder](https://juanitorduz.github.io/numpyro_forecast/reference/contrib.blackjax.fit_pathfinder.html)

#### Datasets
> Example datasets used in the tutorials.

- [datasets.load_bart_weekly](https://juanitorduz.github.io/numpyro_forecast/reference/datasets.load_bart_weekly.html)
- [datasets.load_bart_hierarchical](https://juanitorduz.github.io/numpyro_forecast/reference/datasets.load_bart_hierarchical.html)
